data.result: Simple-derived-factor subdirect products have slope-detected torsion-free abelianizations; full F congruence fibre products cannot replicate the wreath torsion.
All solvable PL images of FP2 groups without free rank-two subgroups are abelian, via credited splitting and Bleak classification.
Every nontrivial finitely generated normal PL subgroup is detected by an ambient real character; abelianization-torsion witnesses normally generate infinitely generated subgroups.
Root uniqueness and balanced powers do not imply root-closed derived subgroups; explicit finitely presented nilpotent countermodels are ruled out of F by a direct germ argument.
